title: Guardrails admin tooling: inspect eval-job queue + replay gating runs with identical inputs
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Internal-only: adds guardrails admin endpoints + console page to inspect eval jobs and replay a gating run with the exact same inputs for debugging.
body:
Context: During the pilot we hit a few cases where the async eval runner backlog caused timeouts and it was hard for oncall to answer basic questions quickly (what is queued, why is it stuck, can we reproduce a decision deterministically). This PR adds an internal admin API + Console admin page to (1) inspect queued/running/completed guardrails eval jobs with filters, (2) fetch a normalized view of a job's inputs/outputs, and (3) replay a prior gating run using the exact same inputs (model version, prompt-set rev, suite selector output, config delta, gating mode settings) to confirm determinism or debug flaky graders.

Scope:
- Control plane API: new admin endpoints under /v1/admin/guardrails/eval-jobs
- Console (admin): basic UI for queue inspection and a guarded "Replay" action
- Replay semantics: enqueues a new job with inputs copied from the original job's persisted request payload; does NOT attempt to reuse cached results (we want a clean re-run), but does annotate the job with replay_of_job_id for traceability.
- Safety: replay is RBAC-restricted to internal roles only; we also add rate limiting + an allowlist to prevent accidental high-volume replays.

Why now:
- Helps oncall triage timeouts/backlog incidents (see SUP-18503 confusion around timeout state and the staging backlog thread).
- Makes it easier to validate fixes for non-deterministic gating decisions (metric ordering, CI calculations) by replaying with identical inputs.

Implementation notes:
- The runner already persists a "job_request" blob. This PR formalizes a stable schema and adds a canonicalized/validated view used by the UI.
- Replay uses the canonicalized request payload; we explicitly re-resolve suite selector output from the original job payload rather than re-running selection logic (avoids drift if selector rules change).
- The UI shows both raw job state (queue/worker) and the gating summary (pass/fail/timeout + metric deltas) when present.

Out of scope:
- Editing job payloads (dangerous); this is intentionally replay-only.
- Bulk replay.

Testing:
- Unit tests for canonicalization + replay request creation.
- Integration test with mocked queue/worker to validate that replayed job has identical inputs and emits audit event.

Follow-ups:
- Add a "download artifacts" shortcut in the admin UI once artifact-service links are stable across regions.
- Consider a read-only Support-facing view (no replay) if we want to reduce escalations.
commits: guardrails/admin: add EvalJobAdminService with list/get/replay (Chloe Martin)
control-plane: persist canonicalized eval job request/summary (Chloe Martin)
console-backend: admin endpoints passthrough + pagination/filtering (Chloe Martin)
console-frontend: Guardrails Eval Jobs admin page + replay modal (Chloe Martin)
rbac: add internal permission guardrails.eval_jobs:read / :replay (Jordan Lee)
tests: integration coverage for replay determinism + audit event emission (Leila Farouk)
conversation:
Sean Gallagher (review): Can we ensure replay doesn't accidentally hit the eval-results cache? Oncall expectation is a clean re-run.
Chloe Martin (author): Yep. Replay enqueues with force_fresh=true and we bypass the caching layer in EvalRunnerFacade when that flag is present. Added a test asserting we do not read from EvalResultCache for replay jobs.

Jordan Lee (review): RBAC: I'd prefer splitting read vs replay permissions. Also, we should capture who initiated the replay and why.
Chloe Martin (author): Done. Added guardrails.eval_jobs:read and guardrails.eval_jobs:replay permissions; replay requires justification text in the UI and it's written to GuardrailsEvalJobReplay audit event (actor_id, justification, replay_of_job_id).

Olivia Grant (review): Replay using suite selector output from the original payload is correct. Please confirm we also pin prompt-set revision and evaluator versions.
Chloe Martin (author): Confirmed. The canonical request includes prompt_set_revision, suite_id, evaluator_bundle_version, and grading_config_hash. Replay copies those fields verbatim; worker logs include them as structured fields.

Felix Schneider (review): UI: please add a clear warning that replay can incur cost and may take time; also show rate-limit errors nicely.
Chloe Martin (author): Added warning copy + dedicated error state for 429s with suggested wait time. Also added a small banner that replay runs are billed to internal guardrails-debug budget tag.

Sean Gallagher (approval): LGTM. This will materially help oncall. Please link this in the runbook after merge.
Chloe Martin (author): Will do in a follow-up PR to the runbook.
